name: Sketch Top
detailed_description:
Sketch Top: A dedicated tool for players who prefer to operate two windows simultaneously, focusing on enabling users to switch between the two windows easily without changing their habits. A must-have tool for painting beginners, allowing you to learn painting without barriers.The Window Player tool restricts the area of mouse activity and focuses on one window operation.

【Play Games and Watch Videos Simultaneously】

If you're used to playing games while watching videos, give it a try. It's more useful than "picture-in-picture". Full-screen gaming doesn't affect normal gaming or display.

When you're idle in the game, pin another window to make it appear in front of the game you're currently playing. Imagine this.

You can play while reading guides, watching videos, or even anime. Of course, you can also study while playing.

It's especially suitable for when the game content becomes boring, allowing you to get another kind of fun without affecting the ongoing game content.

The software is local and offline, can be started independently, has no other content, is easy to uninstall, small in size, and low in resource usage.

The software has unique functions. When switching to the game window, the window to be pinned can automatically penetrate the mouse, so even if it blocks the game interface, it won't affect your operation of the game; when switching to the pinned window, it can automatically allow you to operate the window with the mouse. This allows you to switch between the two windows seamlessly.

With the function of changing the transparency of the pinned window, you don't have to worry about the window blocking the content of the game window when playing games. Even if you don't like to use this function, you can use the shortcut key to cancel the pinned window.

【Practice Sketching on Computer】

Longing to practice drawing but don't have time in reality. Want to learn painting but afraid of not being able to. Now, just open a picture and you can easily practice painting. The software comes with a "Sketch Picture" button, making painting easy and practicing aesthetics. It removes the barriers to painting. Think back to how you learned to write as a child, now as long as you want, you can learn to paint.

The "Sketch Picture" button is designed to help users better use the software. As mentioned above, this is a feature of the software, allowing users to learn painting.

Practicing painting can also improve users' control over the mouse, which is very helpful for playing shooting games.

The "Focus Mode" is designed not only to make the desktop cleaner but also to effectively use desktop space.

The "Minimize" function is designed to meet user needs, making the software directly become a "lazy software". It can be minimized with one shortcut key.

The "Seamless Switch" is designed to not change users' usage habits while having a pinned window at any time.

We hope you will like this software. Alt+Tab is the key to using this software.
